gaps.title: Missing Employee Surname Search in Dossier API
gaps.jtbd: When an operator searches for an employee dossier by surname, I want the backend API to query and return documents matching the employee surname, so that documents can be selected and inspected when only the employee surname is known.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an employee surname parameter in the search request, When GET /api/v1/dossier/documents is called with the surname, Then the backend returns all documents associated with that employee surname.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: The client brief explicitly mandates selecting all associated documents by specific employee surname ('по конкретному сотруднику/фамилии'), but EmployeeDossierController only accepts an exact employee_id parameter.

gaps.title: Dossier Search UI API Integration Missing
gaps.jtbd: When a user searches for an employee dossier and requests a summary report in the frontend interface, I want the component to fetch real document data and issue report generation requests to the backend API, so that users can view real documents and receive generated reports.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a user interacting with DossierSearch.svelte, When the user searches or clicks to generate a report, Then the component issues HTTP requests to /api/v1/dossier endpoints and displays the returned data.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: Frontend UI components built for user-facing dossier search and report creation must connect to backend dossier endpoints rather than returning hardcoded static mock lists.
